hooks.name: CDK validate on infra change
hooks.description: When any file under infra/ is saved, run cdk synth to validate the CloudFormation template.

action.command: ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$ROOT/infra" || exit 0; echo "[cdk-validate hook] cdk synth..." >&2; if npx cdk synth --quiet >/tmp/ss_synth.log 2>&1; then echo "[cdk-validate hook] cdk synth OK" >&2; else echo "[cdk-validate hook] cdk synth FAILED:" >&2; tail -25 /tmp/ss_synth.log >&2; fi; exit 0
